definition: Legacy mean normalized corrected whole-range tail score; unchanged from existing scatters.
method: Within-mouse change then cage mean. Equal cohort weight for contrasts. Resample cages with replacement separately within each cohort/group; keep whole-cage changes intact. Percentile95% intervals.
caution: One WALK cage in TMCS3 cannot contribute estimated within-cell bootstrap variation; intervals may underrepresent uncertainty. Layout/estimation prototype only. Original exact-permutation Holm p-values retained; no new testing hierarchy. Bootstrap intervals are unadjusted and need not agree with adjusted p-values.
